sentences.ar: جدتي كانت أحسن طباخة بالعيلة كلها.
sentences.en: My grandmother was the best cook in the whole family.

words.caphi_raw: t. a b b aa kh

sentences.ar: أكلها كان له طعمة ما في متلها.
sentences.en: Her food had a taste like no other.

words.caphi_raw: 2 a k a l h a

sentences.ar: كل النسوان بالعيلة حاولوا يقلدوا أكلها.
sentences.en: All the women in the family tried to imitate her cooking.

sentences.ar: بس ولا وحدة قدرت توصل لنفس الطعمة.
sentences.en: But not one of them could reach the same taste.

words.caphi_raw: t w a s. s. a l

sentences.ar: مرة، سألتها إمي: شو سرك يا حجة؟
sentences.en: Once, my mom asked her: what's your secret, hajjeh?

sentences.ar: جدتي ضحكت وقالت: السر مش بالبهارات.
sentences.en: My grandmother laughed and said: the secret isn't in the spices.

words.caphi_raw: b h aa r aa t

sentences.ar: قالت: السر إنك تطبخي وقلبك مليان محبة.
sentences.en: She said: the secret is that you cook with your heart full of love.

sentences.en: My mom didn't understand the words at first.

sentences.ar: بس بعد ما توفت جدتي، بلشت تفهم.
sentences.en: But after my grandmother passed away, she began to understand.

sentences.ar: صارت إمي تطبخ لنا نفس الأكلات.
sentences.en: My mom started cooking us the same dishes.

words.caphi_raw: t. a b b i kh

sentences.ar: وكانت تحط فيها كل محبتها لإلنا.
sentences.en: And she would put all her love for us into them.

words.caphi_raw: m a 7 a b b a

sentences.ar: شوي شوي، صار أكل إمي يشبه أكل جدتي.
sentences.en: Little by little, my mom's food started to resemble my grandmother's.

sentences.ar: يوم، ذقت أكلها وحسيت إنه جدتي رجعت.
sentences.en: One day, I tasted her food and felt my grandmother had come back.

sentences.ar: قلتلها: هيك بالضبط كانت تطبخ جدتي.
sentences.en: I told her: this is exactly how grandma used to cook.
